test_sample_discrete_gaussian: test the discrete_gaussian.sample_discrete_gaussian function to generate integer samples from a discrete Gaussian distribution
test_get_sampling_parameters: test the discrete_gaussian._get_sampling_parameters function to compute laplace_scale and oversample parameters
test_sigma_zero_behavior: test that discrete_gaussian.sample_discrete_gaussian with sigma=0 returns an array of zeros
test_negative_sigma_validation: test that discrete_gaussian.sample_discrete_gaussian raises ValueError for negative sigma
test_deterministic_seeded_rng: test that discrete_gaussian.sample_discrete_gaussian produces identical results with the same RNG seed
